[mathematical] The smoothness regularizer has the wrong sign in the stated objective.

**Where:** Section II-B, Eq. (1), with the definitions in Eqs. (2)–(3).

**What is wrong:** The paper defines the training loss as
\[
L = L_{\mathrm{recon}} - \lambda_s L_{\mathrm{smooth}} + \lambda_e L_{\mathrm{stretch}}.
\]
...
If the loss is minimized, the negative sign in front of \(L_{\mathrm{smooth}}\) rewards larger neighboring-vertex differences rather than penalizing them.
...

\[
L = L_{\mathrm{recon}} + \lambda_s L_{\mathrm{smooth}} + \lambda_e L_{\mathrm{stretch}},
\]
